nodes.title: Note
widgets_values:
## Portraius Studio: element sheets

An outfit, prop or location from photos, as a clean product-style sheet and four views, the way the app makes elements (spec: Character vault, Elements). Each type has its own prompts, so each has its own group.

1. Put a photo in `ComfyUI/input/` as `my-prop-1.jpg` and run: the **Prop** group is on.
2. For an outfit or a location, select that group's nodes and press **Ctrl+B** to turn them on (they start bypassed), then add its photo.

The app takes 1 to 6 photos: add Load Image nodes and wire them into each Nano Banana node's next image slot, before the sheet. Leave out logos, brand names and trademarked designs: the contest bans unlicensed IP.

Needs a Comfy account with credits: these are partner nodes.

nodes.title: Prop sheet
widgets_values:
Create a clean reference sheet of the object shown in the attached photos.
Keep its exact shape, proportions, colours, materials, textures and every detail.
Layout: one 16:9 image. Plain mid-grey studio background, soft even lighting, like a product photograph.
Panels left to right: the front view of the object; a three-quarter view of the object; the side view of the object; a close-up of the object's materials, surface and details.
Do not add, remove or redesign anything.
No people, no logos or brand names, no text, labels, borders or watermarks.
